description: Source file implementing functions and classes for handling AVC (H.264) parameter sets and conversion between Annex B and AVCC formats in media processing.

classes.name: AvcParameterSets
classes.description: Class managing AVC parameter sets, parsing from Annex B format, and converting to other formats.

methods.name: StartsWithAnnexBHeader
methods.description: Checks if data starts with the Annex B header pattern.

methods.name: AdvanceToNextAnnexBHeader
methods.description: Advances pointer to the next Annex B header in the data stream.

methods.name: ExtractAnnexBNalu
methods.description: Extracts a NALU (Network Abstraction Layer Unit) from Annex B formatted data.

methods.name: AvcParameterSets::AvcParameterSets
methods.description: Constructor that parses AVC parameter sets from Annex B data.

methods.name: AvcParameterSets::GetAllSpses
methods.description: Returns all SPS (Sequence Parameter Set) NALUs.

methods.name: AvcParameterSets::GetAllPpses
methods.description: Returns all PPS (Picture Parameter Set) NALUs.

methods.name: AvcParameterSets::ConvertTo
methods.description: Converts parameter sets to a different format (e.g., headless).

methods.name: AvcParameterSets::operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operator for AVC parameter sets.

methods.name: AvcParameterSets::operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison operator for AVC parameter sets.

methods.name: ConvertAnnexBToAvcc
methods.description: Converts Annex B formatted data to AVCC format.
